MainClaimedReleaseTransitionReceipt.description: Release transition receipt that cannot exist without the one-use claim.
MainClaimedReleaseTransitionReceipt.title: MainClaimedReleaseTransitionReceipt

MainCompletionPackage.description:
Final immutable package; its child refs are checked by the journal.

``MainReleaseTransitionReceipt`` is retained as a historical C1-C3
observation for compatibility with the earlier evidence chain.  It is not
release authority for a C4 completion.  A C4 package must also carry the
durable lease, one-use claim, claim-bound transition receipt, and the
release-transition mutation chain below.  The fence resolution is an
explicitly supplied ``None`` for the normal terminal path and an observed
resolution for an ambiguous dispatch path; it is intentionally not a
default so a caller cannot omit the branch decision.
MainCompletionPackage.title: MainCompletionPackage

MainCompositionArtifact.description: Deterministic application of the source delta to one fresh main base.
MainCompositionArtifact.title: MainCompositionArtifact

MainCompositionProof.description:
Durable, controller-rooted proof of the exact C2 composition.

The proof is intentionally data, rather than a verifier object.  A journal
can therefore validate it after restart without importing or trusting a
caller supplied implementation.  The implementation and base-observer
identities are allow-listed by the journal's controller root.
MainCompositionProof.title: MainCompositionProof

MainDeltaManifest.description: The exact sole-parent-to-result delta selected from the source package.
MainDeltaManifest.title: MainDeltaManifest

MainExternalIdentity.description: Content-addressed identity of one external object or action.
MainExternalIdentity.title: MainExternalIdentity

MainGraduationIntent.description:
Immutable C4 intent bound to the durable Phase-A lease record.

``MainLeaseEvidence`` is the historical C2 lease shape.  It remains
represented as an optional compatibility member so old model-constructed
values can still be inspected, but a validated C4 intent must carry the
Phase-A ``MainLeaseEvidenceRecord`` and all of its authority digests.
MainGraduationIntent.title: MainGraduationIntent

MainInverseDeltaArtifact.description: Typed inverse of a completed main result; opaque rollback digests are forbidden.
MainInverseDeltaArtifact.title: MainInverseDeltaArtifact

MainLeaseEvidence.description: Durable main-target lease proof; opaque lease digests are insufficient.
MainLeaseEvidence.title: MainLeaseEvidence

MainLeaseEvidenceRecord.description: Public durable lease record returned by the main journal API.
MainLeaseEvidenceRecord.title: MainLeaseEvidenceRecord

MainMergeGroupWebhookReceipt.description: Durable receipt of one authenticated native merge-group webhook.
MainMergeGroupWebhookReceipt.title: MainMergeGroupWebhookReceipt

MainMutationFenceResolution.description: Append-only closure fact for an unresolved mutation fence.
MainMutationFenceResolution.title: MainMutationFenceResolution

MainMutationIntent.description: Append-only intent written before dispatching any external mutation.
MainMutationIntent.title: MainMutationIntent

MainMutationReceipt.description: Create-once provider receipt for exactly one mutation intent.
MainMutationReceipt.title: MainMutationReceipt

MainPreparationAuthorization.description: Reversible authorization; it cannot authorize a main mutation.
MainPreparationAuthorization.title: MainPreparationAuthorization

MainProviderPostStateObservation.description:
Provider-attested post-state for the protected target.

Git object names in a coordinator receipt are claims until a provider
observation binds them to an authoritative read-after-write response.
This record is the typed, content-addressed post-state evidence required
by the C4 completion contract.
MainProviderPostStateObservation.title: MainProviderPostStateObservation

MainQueueAdmissionObservation.description: One-use, PR-head-only admission proof (never group evidence).
MainQueueAdmissionObservation.title: MainQueueAdmissionObservation

MainQueueConfigurationObservation.description: The authoritative, empty queue configuration read before enqueue.
MainQueueConfigurationObservation.title: MainQueueConfigurationObservation

MainQueueObservation.description: The authoritative singleton queue state read after enqueue.
MainQueueObservation.title: MainQueueObservation

MainReleaseAuthorization.description: Single-use authority consumed only by the isolated release issuer.
MainReleaseAuthorization.title: MainReleaseAuthorization

MainReleaseClaim.description: Atomic, create-once claim consumed before isolated release dispatch.
MainReleaseClaim.title: MainReleaseClaim

MainReleaseHoldObservation.description: Distinct pending group-specific hold, created after queue admission.
MainReleaseHoldObservation.title: MainReleaseHoldObservation

MainReleaseIssuerBinding.description: Immutable controller root for release and integration-package authority.
MainReleaseIssuerBinding.title: MainReleaseIssuerBinding

MainRollbackAttemptAuthority.description:
Durable, controller-derived identity for one rollback attempt.

The operation id is deliberately derived from immutable rollback facts and
an explicit nonce.  Operational metadata (leases, provider responses, and
timestamps) is intentionally absent from this identity manifest so replay
cannot accidentally create a second operation for the same attempt.
MainRollbackAttemptAuthority.title: MainRollbackAttemptAuthority

MainRollbackCleanupIntent.description: Append-only intent to remove the rollback candidate/PR after completion.
MainRollbackCleanupIntent.title: MainRollbackCleanupIntent

MainRollbackCleanupObservation.description: Read-only provider observation resolving cleanup idempotency/ambiguity.
MainRollbackCleanupObservation.title: MainRollbackCleanupObservation

MainRollbackCleanupReceipt.description: Create-once provider receipt for rollback candidate cleanup.
MainRollbackCleanupReceipt.title: MainRollbackCleanupReceipt

MainRollbackCleanupTerminalEvidence.description: Terminal proof that rollback candidate resources are absent.
MainRollbackCleanupTerminalEvidence.title: MainRollbackCleanupTerminalEvidence

MainRollbackPostStateObservation.description: Authenticated read-after-write state for the final protected result.
MainRollbackPostStateObservation.title: MainRollbackPostStateObservation

MainRollbackPreparationAuthorization.description: Reversible rollback preparation, distinct from historical graduation wires.
MainRollbackPreparationAuthorization.title: MainRollbackPreparationAuthorization

MainRollbackResultReceipt.description:
Provider receipt for the exact protected rollback result.

A successful receipt carries one and only one result parent.  Rejected or
invalid provider responses may carry no result objects; ambiguity remains
an explicit durable outcome and cannot be treated as success.
MainRollbackResultReceipt.title: MainRollbackResultReceipt

MainSourcePackageBinding.description: Immutable binding to a complete successful integration package.
MainSourcePackageBinding.title: MainSourcePackageBinding
